 October 29, 2026 Share Here & Now 's Robin Young speaks with Alabama healthcare navigator Rebecca Sylvester , who advises people on which Affordable Care Act health insurance plan best suits their needs as open enrollment approaches next week.
 She says a growing number of people are choosing higher-deductible plans or dropping coverage altogether because premiums are going up around $200 dollars per month. COVID-era Obamacare subsidies are no longer available, and many people earn too much to qualify for Medicaid.
 This segment aired on October 29, 2026.
